verdictRationale: The owner-free pinned-consumption gap is closed on exact product SHA 1c2549c315: additive governed-only Chat and Idea routes require snapshotId+version+contentHash, persist that exact ref inside the proposal hash and an immutable binding receipt, and replay without resolving live/latest context. Legacy routes remain compatible and are not dual-written. Literal task remains PARTIAL only because browser/human G4 was outside this backend package.
open: Mounted browser/human G4 for the user-facing governed snapshot selection flow remains NOT_VERIFIED.

Validates tenant/id/version/hash and records proposal+binding in one pinned PostgreSQL UoW with proposal locking for race-safe replay.
Signed-JWT mounted Chat+Idea, eight-way exactly-once, fail-closed, immutable, cold and restart proof.
